verdict.rationale: A Secretary of State business-filing service could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, or any public API. The pack covers only portal login, filer guides, tax tools and robots.txt probes that returned 403, none of which shows a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
